scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen-oh-seven... two territories were married. And a new state was born.

scenes.label: The Twin Territories
scenes.caption: Rand McNally map, 1892
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Theodore Roosevelt's proclamation joined Oklahoma Territory and Indian Territory.

scenes.label: Guthrie, Oklahoma
scenes.caption: Guthrie in 1893
scenes.text: [warmly] In Guthrie, crowds watched a mock wedding... a groom for Oklahoma Territory, and a Cherokee bride for Indian Territory.

scenes.title: Oklahoma's first governor
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Then Charles Haskell became the first governor.
